data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 gross claims outstanding were GBP 590.161m. During 2018 prior-year development (primarily on the 2016 underwriting year) showed an adverse movement of approximately GBP 18.4m, driven largely by natural catastrophe activity in 2018. Separately, a large external reinsurance-to-close of the 2008-2015 years completed in 2017 resulted in a substantial release of reserves relating to pre-2016 years (c. GBP 405.1m).
raw_causal_phrases: Both 2017 and 2018 were also affected by catastrophe losses and reserves have been established in 2018 for Hurricanes Florence and Michael as well as the Californian wildfires ($100.8m gross and $27.4m net).

data.data_quality_notes: Primary gross opening reserves taken from the Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2017). Prior-year development computed from the gross claims development table (triangle) using the 2016 column only (2017 and 2018 excluded)  yields +GBP 18.37m adverse movement. The report contains a large RITC item (2015 & prior) which materially distorts movement in total reserves; the triangle columns begin at 2016 so the triangle-based PYD excludes the RITC-affected aggregated older years. Some loss amounts in the narrative are reported in USD (e.g. $100.8m gross / $27.4m net) and were not converted to GBP; net-losses for named events are therefore null in GBP. LOB movement amounts are not separately quantified in the notes and are inferred; amounts are null where not stated.
